title: Localization away from the boundary: the restriction to U ∖ spt ∂T is a minimizing cycle
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, A ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in A (IsMinimizingIn T A). Put U' := U ∖ spt ∂T (U \ boundarySupport T) and let T' ∈ 𝒟_n(U') be the restriction of T (T.restrictDomain). Then (a) U' is open; (b) T' is minimizing in A as a current in U'; (c) ∂T' = 0 in U' (BoundaryVanishes T'); (d) spt T' ⊆ spt T; (e) M_W(T') = M_W(T) for every W ⊆ U'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → 0 < n → IsMinimizingIn T A → IsOpen (U \ boundarySupport T) ∧ IsMinimizingIn (T.restrictDomain (Set.sdiff_subset : U \ boundarySupport T ⊆ U)) A ∧ BoundaryVanishes (T.restrictDomain (Set.sdiff_subset : U \ boundarySupport T ⊆ U)) ∧ (T.restrictDomain (Set.sdiff_subset : U \ boundarySupport T ⊆ U)).support ⊆ T.support ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), W ⊆ U \ boundarySupport T → (T.restrictDomain (Set.sdiff_subset : U \ boundarySupport T ⊆ U)).massOn W = T.massOn W
